entities.summary: George M. Wikoff is a United States Navy admiral who has served as the commander of U.S. Naval Forces Europe and Africa and Allied Joint Force Command Naples since 2025. He previously served as the commander of U.S. Naval Forces Central Command, U.S. Fifth Fleet, and Combined Maritime Forces from 2024 to 2025. During his command of U.S. Navy forces in the Middle East, he oversaw combat operations in the Red Sea crisis and the Twelve-Day War.
